entities.name: Thorn
entities.description: One of the five legendary green kirin kami of Kamigawa.

entities.name: The Great One
entities.description: Kami whose war Thorn considers folly.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: Place of the teahouse in a painting.

events.summary: The five kirin meet in a teahouse inside a painting in Minamo as the Kami War begins.
events.quote: As the Kami War began, the five kirin met up as they do every 1,000 years.

events.summary: Thorn argues that kami and mortals are part of the same whole.
events.quote: Thorn argued that both Kami and mortals were a part of the rhythm of nature and were a part of the same whole.

events.summary: Scale argues against Thorn, who is not swayed.
events.quote: Though, Thorn would not be swayed believing he has seen the good in mortals.

events.summary: Thorn is the last to leave the teahouse.
events.quote: Thorn was the last to leave the teahouse

relations.quote: he believes The Great One 's war is folly
